==Description==
*'''A-85i''' is a magenta, three-eyed face, which contains a wide smile with a set of large, magenta teeth, and eyes with symbolized purple shapes. It can easily be identified by its loud whispers.

==Behavior==
*When '''A-85i''' spawns, it will make loud whispers that decrease in pitch. After it's done whispering, it will move backwards.
*After '''A-85i''' moves backwards, a door counter will begin, starting at 5. (Each '''successful rebound''' increases this by 1)
*Each door opened will decrease the door counter by one.
*'''A-85i''' will wait a random time between 45 and 100 seconds, '''ENRAGED''' or not.
*After '''A-85i's''' wait time is over, he will rush forward to the current room.
*If you got the door counter to 0, he will make 2 loud "Beep" sounds and then leave shortly after. This is known as a ''Successful rebound''.
*If the door counter is above 0, he will not make the beep sound, but rather make you want to leave your hiding spot. The door counter will reset. This is known as an '''Unsuccessful rebound'''.
*After 3 '''successful rebounds''', '''A-85i''' will become '''ENRAGED''', making a loud scream when it charges up.
*When '''A-85i''' is '''ENRAGED''', his sound will play at a faster speed, and he will be faster. Giving barely any time to react.
*'''A-85i''' OST (og rooms ambience) will now start playing, as soon he screams.
*After 6 to 8 '''Successful rebounds''', '''A-85i''' will produce a loud wind sound and disappear once it rushes to the front.

==Strategy & Tips==
* When '''A-85i''' spawns, wait 2-3 seconds or after the Spawn sound ends, and then hide inside of a locker.

* '''A-85i''' cant locker snipe, use this to your advantage!

* [https://youtu.be/ZHSpOVpi7ho&t Video Representation]

==Trivia==
*'''A-85i''' is a '''Mini-boss''' entity.
*'''A-85i''' is the prime variant of [[A-85]], with a 1/100 chance of replacing him.
*'''A-85i''' is forced to spawn at door A-901 (if there is no lockers in A-901 he will wait for a room with lockers to spawn) if the player started from door A-000.
